mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool often used to determine a student's ability."
Diagnostic testing is a tool often used to determine a student's ability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an approach to reading instruction based on activities and stories developed form the personal experiences of the learner."
The language experience approach is an approach to reading instruction based on activities and stories developed form the personal experiences of the learner.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a productive skill which is acquired through the maturational process; a child who does not suffer a speech defect will eventually speak."
Speaking is a productive skill which is acquired through the maturational process; a child who does not suffer a speech defect will eventually speak.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to words that mean something other than what they say."
Figurative language refers to words that mean something other than what they say.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to monitor the progress of children and how well they have learnt or not."
Evaluation is used to monitor the progress of children and how well they have learnt or not.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used which gives the cloth its special blue color."
An indigo dye is used which gives the cloth its special blue color.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a strategy that aids lifelong learning."
Silent reading is a strategy that aids lifelong learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a more structured interaction between the teacher and a pupil."
Interviewing is a more structured interaction between the teacher and a pupil.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the primary building blocks of reading."
Phonics is one of the primary building blocks of reading.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the four language skills."
Listening is one of the four language skills.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of forming a new word by adding "s" "es" "ed" etc., to the base word."
Inflection is the process of forming a new word by adding "s" "es" "ed" etc., to the base word.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an experience which aids the pupils in their effort to read."
Participation in short drama pieces is an experience which aids the pupils in their effort to read.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used mainly for formative purposes i.e. to find out how well learners are doing during teaching."
Tests are used mainly for formative purposes i.e. to find out how well learners are doing during teaching.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the cornerstone of success in school and in the larger society."
Reading with understanding is the cornerstone of success in school and in the larger society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a traditional cloth made by Yoruba women in western Nigeria."
Adire is a traditional cloth made by Yoruba women in western Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of words that he had learnt during oral language activities."
A child's sight vocabulary is made up of words that he had learnt during oral language activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process whereby new words are derived from the base word by adding syllables either at the beginning, or after the base word."
Affixation is the process whereby new words are derived from the base word by adding syllables either at the beginning, or after the base word.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the order of events or steps in a story or passage."
Sequence is the order of events or steps in a story or passage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of reading a passage to get a rough idea of what the passage is about."
Skimming is the process of reading a passage to get a rough idea of what the passage is about.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of making sense of words, sentences and connected texts."
Comprehension is the process of making sense of words, sentences and connected texts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a technique for working out word pronunciation by identifying and combining sound elements in words."
Using phonetic clues is a technique for working out word pronunciation by identifying and combining sound elements in words.
